//: One override, because one thing was broken.
Vercel sets NODE_ENV=production for the install, so pnpm skips
devDependencies - and `typescript` and `prisma` are devDependencies, which
is where build tools belong. The build then died on `tsc: command not
found` and `prisma: command not found` before compiling a single file.
`--prod=false` says: install everything, including the tools needed to
produce the thing being deployed. It does not put devDependencies into the
runtime bundle - Next decides what ships, and this only affects what exists
The alternative, moving typescript and prisma into `dependencies`, would
make every consumer of the eleven published packages download a compiler
Nothing else is set on purpose. Vercel's own detection already found the
Next.js app and scoped turbo to `@adysre/web` and its dependencies - the
build log says so - and overriding a buildCommand or outputDirectory that
already works is how a targeted fix becomes a second outage.
